notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates blur to mostly white with a small blue hint on the left.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Cyrillic and Latin scripts both appear; extra letters like Ә, Ғ, Қ, Ң, Ө, Ұ and Ү do not exist in the northern neighbour's alphabet.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage was shot from a white pickup truck, fully visible or mostly blurred.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Huge, open, flat and empty rural landscapes: steppe, desert, mountain passes and birch forests.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Pedestrian signs, poles, houses and bollards closely resemble those of the northern neighbour.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Yellow and white striped crossings that often have white dashes on both sides.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Blue building-mounted street signs with ornate white patterns top and bottom, often bilingual or trilingual and sometimes with a QR code.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Post-Soviet and Turkish-style bollards, plus a unique pair of thin bollards joined at 90 degrees.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Tree trunk bases are very often painted white.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are mostly yellow and black, with red and white ones only at T junctions.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Above-ground gas pipes are extremely common in cities.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Ornamental horn-pattern decorations everywhere and ornate entrance arcs at the edges of towns.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is limited: major roads and cities, few small rural roads.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage seasons split the country: summer in the west and centre, autumn in the northeast, winter in the southeast.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Area codes follow an east-to-west pattern along three horizontal bands.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Lush birch forests beside green fields in the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Vast green grassy plains in the northwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Sandy, shrubby desert-like landscapes in the southwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Tall, often snow-capped mountains and winter snow in the southeast.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The far east is hilly and forested, with autumn colours.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Poles are painted in region-specific colour bands, which are worth learning.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: City bus stops and buses have distinctive designs per city.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Red and white km markers like those in a neighbour appear only near one southern town.
